title: Northbridge University
useCase: Slack for Education, backed by Education Cloud. Student services works one application with finance and accommodation, a lecturer prepares a 1:1 from the student record, and a student gets help in Slack without a Salesforce licence.
beats: Jordan's BA History application moves to Application Decision. The offer is Admit, Jordan has accepted, and the conversation is the Salesforce record channel for that Individual Application.
Sam in finance and Riley in accommodation work that same channel, with the deposit case and the room hold in view.
Jordan has gone quiet. Alex messages Jordan directly. Jordan is not in the record channel. Alex brings the reply back to that channel.
Slackbot answers whether a visa can defer the tuition deposit, from the staff handbook canvas, and cites the source.
Jamie asks for a loan laptop in #student-services. The enquiry is a case Alex owns. Slackbot updates it only after a preview and approval.
Slackbot catches Casey up on #course-channel and #seminar.
Casey reads Jamie's program enrollment, 6 of 8 sessions, and follows up in #seminar.
Jordan replies, is welcomed in, and meets Jamie on the history course.
Slackbot answers the laptop FAQ from the student canvas. Alex replies on the case in Slack.
Trust and safety: student channels stay with the people in them, Slackbot answers from the canvases shown, and students have no Salesforce licence.

slack.story:
Northbridge University
Slack for Education, backed by Education Cloud.
1. Jordan's accepted BA History application is one channel. Alex, Sam, and Riley work it.
2. Alex nudges Jordan, who has gone quiet.
3. Slackbot answers a visa deposit question from the staff handbook.
4. Jamie's laptop enquiry is a case, updated through Slackbot after approval.
5. Casey catches up on the course and seminar, reads Jamie's enrollment, and posts in #seminar.
6. Jordan arrives, meets Jamie, and uses the course channels.
7. Close on trust and safety.
Tag: [demo-builder:edu-ido]

manualSteps.title: Install the workspace app on the Enterprise Grid org
manualSteps.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it on the Enterprise Grid org, not on a single workspace. Grant it to Northbridge University. This app posts the seeded scenes as the cast. It does not answer as Slackbot. The user token also needs admin.conversations:manage_objects so it can create a Salesforce record channel.

manualSteps.title: Store a user token for each person who speaks
manualSteps.detail: Each speaker needs their own user token with chat:write, granted on the Northbridge University workspace. Keep the tokens in the coding agent's secret store. Do not put them in a Salesforce named credential. Keep them out of git.

manualSteps.title: Connect the Salesforce org to seed
manualSteps.detail: Sign the coding agent into the Salesforce org that should receive the records. A demo org is the usual choice. The agent uses whichever org that login opens. This login does not connect Slack.

manualSteps.title: Make Jordan's application a Salesforce record channel
manualSteps.detail: Individual Application is already enabled for Slack Channels for Records. Jordan's record channel is staff only: Alex, Sam, and Riley. Friendly Name on the application is the channel name, student name plus subject code. The applicant conversation is a direct message and the course channel, with no Salesforce record in it.

manualSteps.title: Ask Slackbot during the webinar
manualSteps.detail: Do not seed messages as Slackbot. In Jordan's record channel ask about deferring the deposit during a visa wait. As Casey, ask what needs attention in the course and seminar. In #course-channel ask what happens when a laptop will not start. In #student-services, ask Slackbot to update Jamie's laptop case and approve only after the preview.

agentSteps.title: Confirm the demo org
agentSteps.detail: Use the Salesforce org this session is signed into. Create the records there. Do not deploy a flow.

agentSteps.title: Workspace Northbridge University
agentSteps.detail: Use the Northbridge University workspace. Post as the cast with each person's user token. Jordan's application is a Salesforce record channel named from Friendly Name. The other channels are #course-channel, #seminar, and #student-services.

agentSteps.title: Jordan's application channel
agentSteps.detail: Create Jordan's Individual Application at Application Decision, with an Admit decision and applicant decision Accept. Create the tuition deposit case and the accommodation hold. The record channel is staff only. Alex messages Jordan separately, then posts the outcome back on the record channel.

agentSteps.title: Casey's course and seminar
agentSteps.detail: Enroll Jamie on the history seminar with 6 attended and 2 absent. Post the course and seminar lines as Casey and Jamie.

agentSteps.title: Arrival and the laptop case
agentSteps.detail: Post Jordan's reply and welcome, Jamie's greeting on the course, and Jamie's laptop request in #student-services. The case is owned by Alex.

agentSteps.title: Handbook, FAQ, and next steps
agentSteps.detail: Create the staff handbook, student FAQ, and next-steps canvases and share them to the channels that need them. Do not post as Slackbot.

agentSteps.title: Save the spec
agentSteps.detail: Write this plan to demos/edu-ido.json with salesforceIds left empty. Put record ids and the Slack workspace id only in demos/edu-ido.links.json.

talkTrack.label: Student services
talkTrack.say: One application, one channel. Jordan accepted the BA History offer. Sam has the deposit, Riley has the room, and the record is the link in the thread.

talkTrack.label: Nudge
talkTrack.show: Alex's direct message, then the record channel
talkTrack.say: Jordan went quiet after accepting. Alex messages Jordan directly. The record channel never includes Jordan. Alex posts the reply back with Sam and Riley.

talkTrack.label: Handbook
talkTrack.say: Ask Slackbot whether a pending visa can defer the tuition deposit. The answer is 14 days, and the source is the staff handbook, Fees, Winter 2026.

talkTrack.label: Enquiry
talkTrack.say: Jamie asks in Slack. Alex replies there in ordinary language. The case stays with Alex. Ask Slackbot to update it, and approve only after the preview.

talkTrack.label: Lecturer
talkTrack.say: Open Jamie's enrollment in Education Cloud: 6 of 8 sessions. Casey's follow-up is in the seminar, and that post does not include the record.

talkTrack.label: Arrival
talkTrack.say: Jordan replies, gets the next steps, and meets Jamie on the history course.

talkTrack.label: FAQ
talkTrack.say: Ask Slackbot what happens when a laptop will not start. It answers from the student FAQ and cites IT, Winter 2026.

talkTrack.label: Close
talkTrack.say: Student channels are only for the people in them. Slackbot answers from the canvases you showed. Jordan and Jamie have no Salesforce licence.
